answer: A concrete defense is stake-backed identity with decaying reputation. Every agent locks a small refundable stake and must build attested work history before earning rewards. A fresh identity starts at its nadir, with zero trust and zero payout, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital instead of being free. Payouts then follow a delta rule: they rise only with verified useful work and fall sharply after failed attestations. That breaks the spiral where sybils farm early rewards to fund more sybils, since each new identity must pay again and climb from zero.
